Offline compile sequence enforced by compileApp.cmd
-----------------------------------------------
1. Validate required local tools/files.
2. Configure PATH to use vendored Node.js runtime at Dependencies\runtime\nodejs\win-x64.
3. Validate Dependencies\package.json and Dependencies\package-lock.json match repository root files.
4. Restore node_modules from Dependencies\node_modules.
5. Validate Next.js SWC win32-x64 native binary exists in restored dependencies; if missing, copy from Dependencies\external\@next\swc-win32-x64-msvc\next-swc.win32-x64-msvc.node.
6. Rebuild npm dependency artifacts offline (npm rebuild --offline).
7. Build the application offline (npm run build).
